title: Balanced Binary Tree
description:
# Balanced Binary Tree

Given a binary tree, determine if it is **height-balanced**.

A **height-balanced** binary tree is a binary tree in which the depth of the two subtrees of every node never differs by more than one.

## Example 1:

**Input:** root = [3,9,20,null,null,15,7]
**Output:** true

## Example 2:

**Input:** root = [1,2,2,3,3,null,null,4,4]
**Output:** false

## Example 3:

**Input:** root = []
**Output:** true

## Constraints:

*   The number of nodes in the tree is in the range `[0, 5000]`.
*   `-10^4 <= Node.val <= 10^4`

solutions.name: Bottom-Up DFS (Optimal)
solutions.description: Compute height bottom-up. Return -1 immediately if any subtree is unbalanced. This avoids repeated height computations.

solutions.name: Top-Down (Brute Force)
solutions.description: For each node, check if the height difference of left and right subtrees is <= 1, then recursively check both subtrees.
